#include <bits/stdc++.h>
 
using LL = long long;
 
const int N=10;
const int M=25;
const int S=1048580;
const int MOD=1000000007;
 
int n,p[N][N],ma[N][N],bin[M],a[N],b[N],f[S],g[S],tot,id[70],pts[M][N],sta[M];
bool vis[N];
 
int ksm(int x,int y)
{
    int ans=1;
    while (y)
    {
        if (y&1) ans=(LL)ans*x%MOD;
        x=(LL)x*x%MOD; y>>=1;
    }
    return ans;
}
 
void initialize()
{
    bin[0]=1;
    for (int i=1;i<=20;i++) bin[i]=bin[i-1]*2;
    scanf("%d",&n);
    int inv=ksm(100,MOD-2);
    for (int i=1;i<=n;i++)
        for (int j=1;j<=n;j++)
            scanf("%d",&p[i][j]),p[i][j]=(LL)p[i][j]*inv%MOD;
    while (n<6) n++,p[n][n]=1;
}
 
bool match_possible(int x)
{
    if (x>3) return true;
    for (int i=1;i<=3;i++)
        if (!vis[i]&&ma[a[x]][b[i]])
        {
            vis[i]=true;
            bool res=match_possible(x+1);
            vis[i]=false;
            if (res) return true;
        }
    return false;
}
 
void explore(int x,int y,int prob)
{
    if (x>3)
    {
        int sum=0;
        for (int i=1;i<=tot;i++)
        {
            for (int j=1;j<=3;j++) b[j]=pts[i][j];
            if (match_possible(1)) sum+=bin[i-1];
        }
        (f[sum]+=prob)%=MOD;
        return;
    }
    ma[a[x]][y]=0;
    if (y==n) explore(x+1,1,(LL)prob*(1-p[a[x]][y])%MOD);
    else explore(x,y+1,(LL)prob*(1-p[a[x]][y])%MOD);
    ma[a[x]][y]=1;
    if (y==n) explore(x+1,1,(LL)prob*p[a[x]][y]%MOD);
    else explore(x,y+1,(LL)prob*p[a[x]][y]%MOD);
}
 
void generate(int x,int y,int s)
{
    if (y==3)
    {
        id[s]=++tot;sta[tot]=s;
        for (int i=1;i<=3;i++) pts[tot][i]=a[i];
        return;
    }
    if (x>n) return;
    generate(x+1,y,s);
    a[y+1]=x;
    generate(x+1,y+1,s+bin[x-1]);
}
 
void prepare()
{
    for (int i=0;i<tot;i++)
        for (int j=0;j<bin[tot];j++)
            if (j&bin[i]) (g[j]+=g[j^bin[i]])%=MOD;
}
 
int main()
{
    initialize();
    generate(1,0,0);
    a[1]=1; a[2]=2; a[3]=3;
    explore(1,1,1);
    for (int i=0;i<bin[tot];i++)
    {
        int t=0;
        for (int j=1;j<=tot;j++)
        {
            int rev=id[bin[n]-1-sta[j]];
            if (i&bin[j-1]) t+=bin[rev-1];
        }
        g[t]=f[i]; f[i]=0;
    }
    a[1]=4; a[2]=5; a[3]=6;
    explore(1,1,1);
    prepare();
    int answer=0;
    for (int i=0;i<bin[tot];i++)
        (answer+=(LL)f[i]*g[bin[tot]-1-i]%MOD)%=MOD;
    printf("%d\n",(1-answer+MOD)%MOD);
    return 0;
}
